implementation: Two zero-C BF16 matrix products per K16 generate signed and absolute partials. Explicit FP32 additions form64/128/256-wide blocks. Outward bounds cover the retained conditional2^-19 native error, block FP32 sums, every original K16 alignment/normalization loss, and prefix additions. One/two token fragments change reuse only. Row eligibility restricts zeros/normal exponents80..174; unsupported rows receive infinite error and original replay. Full-cell GPU compaction uses one allocation per256-thread CTA. Ambiguous results use unchanged lossless36-byte prepared rows and four-lane staged2 replay, at most262144 selected cells per dispatch. No production dispatcher is changed.
correctness_scope: Host tests are algebra checks with three simulated native-error profiles, not native instructions or a hardware proof. Generated native matrices compare every interval/certificate with independent CPU K16 dots, and validate unsupported rows and the complete candidate permutation; this small fixture does not execute candidate replay. The full fixture first computes every original canonical FP32 value, checks all BF16 endpoints against the GB10 operator reference, and independently checks256 CPU dots per projection. Every warmup/measured variant then checks all final BF16 cells, selected raw FP32 replay, all candidate intervals against canonical values, unchanged unselected centers, immutable original inputs, all prepared words, row flags, candidate membership/tails and guards. QKV repeats1023 captured input/reference rows after7169; OUT repeats1023 inputs and uses an already8192-row GB10 reference. Neither reference is a candidate compute input. No model or token loop is run.
timing_scope: Five variants rotate through one warmup and three measured attempts. Every completed host clock includes full lossless weight/input preparation, actual matrix producer, row norms or eligibility, GPU compaction, host count read and exact replay. The preparation_producer_selection_ms field ends after count read; complete_route_ms includes replay. Original complete canonical generation, allocations, resets, downloads and all verification are outside clocks. Host process walls and pinned build identities are attached. No TTFT or decode throughput is measured.
numerical_limit: The retained zero-C native2^-19 error envelope is conditional; passing all observations does not establish a universal hardware bound. Generated and captured component correctness does not qualify unmeasured model continuations.
